name: Hammurabi Handoff — JIT Vault
description: Just-in-time credential vault for AI agents: per-action, payload-bound, 60-second Ed25519 credentials behind an x402 payment gate, with a human-readable audit feed (RAMesh) for every agent action.

intent_announce.description: Post a structured agent intent to the RAMesh feed

input.intent: AgentIntent (optional; empty body mints the demo intent)

credential_minting.description: x402-gated execution: burns a settled receipt, mints a chaos-tested ephemeral Ed25519 credential bound to the intent payload, returns the gasless settlement envelope

payment_settlement.description: x402 settlement for an intent (LOCAL MOCK in this build — live facilitator is an opt-in feature)
payment_settlement.fee: free (the settlement IS the 0.50 USDC payment)

audit_feed.description: The RAMesh transcript — every gate, vault, and relay action as human-readable lines

integrations.okx_edge: live — OKX marketplace invocations are dispatched through iedb-oka::interop into the same in-process Handoff router as the UI (okx_bridge), so every OKX request passes the identical x402 gate; single enforcement point, no bypass
integrations.x402: middleware live; settlement mocked locally by default
integrations.oneshot: envelope formatting live; broadcast stubbed (local:// endpoint)
integrations.stylus: Rust reference verifier live (settlement::verify_handoff — byte-level, no_std-portable, mirrors the on-chain contract); envelope self-verifies off the wire form. On-chain deployment is roadmap G-1 (not claimed as deployed).

sovereignty.key_persistence: none — ephemeral per-mint, seed zeroized in-frame
sovereignty.clock_discipline: caller-supplied time on all cryptographic paths
